messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['Cahoot has updated its enhanced security system which will virtually eliminate fraud and totally protect you.', 'WE HAVE TEMPORARILY LIMITED YOUR ACCOUNT SENSITIVE FEATURES DUE TO THE SUCCESSFUL UPDATE OF OUR NEW SECURITY ALERTS SERVICE!', 'One of your Google Ads Customer s account attached to your MCC Account has stopped running this morning.', 'This transaction cannot be completed due to errors present in your account information.', 'This is your official notification that the service(s) listed below will be deactivated and deleted if your profile is not verified immediately.', 'For your safety, PayPal set your account status to limited.', 'Your PayPal Account Will Be Deactivated', 'Access to your accounts has been blocked due to a system error.', 'We have implemented security measures consistent with our internal information security pr...', 'Your DHL parcel arrived at our post office since 5th June 2017.', 'We would like to inform you that we have released a new version of Bank of America Customer Form.', 'During the regular update and verification process of HSBC Account, we could not verify your current information.', 'Your PayPal account is Limited.', 'The policy of the Bank however stipulates a limited time period for such inheritance to be made, or the fund will be written off going by the record of the incident, the time limit for the claim is closing up.', 'Your Online Bank Account has been temporarily Suspended.', 'In accordance with Scotia Bank Online User Agreement and to ensure that your account has not been accessed from fraudulent locations, access to your account has been limited.', 'We 19ve noticed that someone else tried to log in from a different location.', 'This is an automatic message from our servers; If you are receiving this message it means that your email address has been queued for deactivation.', 'YOUR EMAIL (ID) HAS WON GBP£820,000.00 ONLY IN YAHOO LOTTERY PROMOTIONS HELD IN YEAR 2009.', 'We detected irregular activity on your Alliance & Leicester Bank Account on 20 June 2010.', 'Important - Internet Banking is about to get even safer', "THERE HAVE BEEN MULTIPLE INVALID LOGON ATTEMPTS TO YOUR ABBEY ONLINE BANKING ACCOUNTS FROM MULTIPLE BLACKLISTED IP'S.", 'we have already sent you The USD$5000.00 dollars through Western Union', 'we notice some suspicious activities on your online banking, and we are putting a hold on your account for your protection.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We provide updates and alerts about account security, suspicious activity, access restrictions, service changes, transactions, deliveries, and important verification deadlines."}
